Welcome to RDC Concrete

Shaping India’s Infrastructure with Digital Precision

RDC Concrete (India) Limited stands as a pioneering and leading force in India's Ready-Mix Concrete (RMC) industry. Established in 1993, we are proud to have set up India's first commercial RMX plant in Mumbai (originally as Unitech Prefab, in association with RDC Concrete Singapore). This ground-breaking step marked the beginning of a revolution in construction practices across the nation.

Today, we take immense pride in being India's largest independent, non-cement backed ready-mix concrete manufacturer and the second-largest RMC company overall by revenue (Fiscal Year 2026).

With an expansive and rapidly growing network of 140 RMC plants strategically spread across the country as of mid-2025, RDC Concrete boasts an unparalleled pan-India presence. Each of our facilities features fully automated and computerized batching systems with capacities ranging from 30m3 to 120 m3 per hour. This meticulous technical control ensures that every mix we deliver to the construction, infrastructure, and real estate industries perfectly complies with the highest Indian Standards.

The Tech-Driven Pioneer: "We Promise, We Deliver"

Widely recognized as the most IT-enabled ready-mix concrete company in India, RDC seamlessly integrates advanced automation across vendor sourcing, internal laboratory design, and customer interactions.

Fleet & Logistics Excellence: Supported by a robust transit network, our deliveries are tracked via our integrated proprietary portal, 'RDCTRAK'. This ensures real-time outbound visibility and predictable scheduling.
AI-Enabled Quality Control: Backed by our state-of-the-art research and development centers, we have pioneered the implementation of AI-driven quality control systems. Our core technical competency is driven by elite concrete technologists and engineers committed to pioneering sustainable concrete technology.
Industrial Validation: Demonstrating our rigorous operational standards, most of our plants are Quality Council of India (QCI) Certified, and RDC actively contributes to the national construction landscape as part of the BIS Codal Committee CED 2.2.
Expanding Our Ecosystem

To provide holistic construction solutions, RDC Concrete extends its capabilities through specialized, wholly-owned subsidiary arms:

Neptune Readymix Concrete Private Limited: Efficiently serving the southern region with a robust output of 25,000 cubic meters of concrete monthly.
Ultrafine Mineral & Admixtures Private Limited: Specializing in eco-friendly microfine cement solutions, including high-performance ultrafine slag and fly-ash micro silica to minimize environmental impact.
Our Shared Vision & Values

As India accelerates toward becoming a $7 trillion economy by 2030, driven by massive infrastructure developments, RDC Concrete is uniquely positioned to lay the literal foundation of this growth. Our ultimate objective is to continuously unlock long-term, sustainable value for our esteemed customers, partners, dedicated employees, and the local communities we serve.

Our Vision: To attain leadership position in providing quality concrete solutions on time, creating customer delight.

The IDEPOSIT Core Values

Our unwavering commitment to excellence is anchored by our shared framework of corporate ethics:

I – Integrity
D – Dedication, Commitment & Teamwork
E – Empathy & Care
P – Positivity
O – Ownership, Accountability & Responsiveness
S – Safety
I – Innovate and Improve to Excel
T – Trust
People First: A Certified Great Place to Work

We firmly believe that our operational excellence is a direct result of our empowering workplace culture. RDC Concrete is proud to be Great Place to Work certified consecutively for the fifth time. We have been recognized among the Top 50 Mid-size Workplaces in 2025 and celebrated as one of the definitive Best Places to Work within the Cement and Building Material Industry.

At RDC, we don't just build structures—we construct lasting, transparent relationships backed by technical precision.

Currently, we operate a total of 140 RMC plants across various regions in India.
